admin.heading: Modularis
admin.help_block: Modularis lets you create reusable CSS blocks and apply them to the site or the admin panel separately. Styles are added to the page and applied immediately. Clearing the cache is usually not required, but you can do it manually if needed.
admin.forum_section_help: These styles are applied to the public forum frontend.
admin.admin_section_help: These styles are applied to the admin panel frontend.
admin.empty: No styles yet. Click "Add style" to create one.
admin.clear_cache_confirm: Clear the Flarum cache? This will also rebuild the style cache.
admin.import_invalid: The file is not a valid Modularis export.
admin.active_switch_help: Toggle to apply or pause this style.
admin.name_help: A short label used to identify this style.
admin.css_help: Paste valid CSS. It is validated on save.
admin.confirm_delete: Delete style "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
admin.error_syntax: The CSS is not valid — unbalanced braces, parentheses or quotes.
admin.error_closing_tag: Closing HTML tags are not allowed.
admin.request_error: Could not save the style. Please check the input and try again.
